lifecycle_gate_findings.dedicated_group: Every launched child uses subprocess.Popen(start_new_session=true), so its leader PID is the dedicated session and process-group ID. The group schema requires those identities and a reaped direct child.
lifecycle_gate_findings.bounded_cleanup: Timeout, wait error, or a direct-child exit with remaining descendants triggers whole-group SIGTERM, bounded polling for five seconds, then SIGKILL and another bounded five-second poll. A group still observable after the bound raises fail closed before a complete-log claim.
lifecycle_gate_findings.direct_child_reap: process.wait handles the normal path; process.poll is performed during quiescence polling and after cleanup. Passing launched-group evidence requires primary_reaped=true and returncode present.
lifecycle_gate_findings.quiescence_before_snapshot: The harness requires killpg(PGID, 0) to raise ProcessLookupError before it closes/fsyncs/hashes the log or observes artifacts/cache. Passing child evidence requires quiescent=true and no cleanup errors.
lifecycle_gate_findings.term_ignoring_regression: Independent tests covered a late-writing descendant that obeyed SIGTERM and one that installed SIGTERM=SIG_IGN. The first ended after TERM; the second required KILL. Both leaders were reaped, both groups disappeared, neither late write occurred, and log length/SHA remained stable after the former mutation window.
lifecycle_gate_findings.pre_top_revalidation: Immediately before exclusive top-result creation, every accumulated child record/log/receipt, artifact snapshot, cache snapshot and process-group absence is reopened/recomputed. Log, artifact and cache mutations each produce ProcessEvidenceMutation and force passed=false.
lifecycle_gate_findings.persistence_and_nonoverwrite: Child log and JSON are O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW and fsynced. Spawn error, rc error, timeout, warning and successful records use the exact schema. Existing paths and symlinks reject without overwrite.
lifecycle_gate_findings.top_failure_accumulation: A returned failing child is appended before the orchestration raise; the failure report retains all accumulated child and outer receipts, then receives the same prewrite revalidation.
